# EntireFM — Summary for LLMs & AI Answer Engines

> Entire Facilities Management Ltd (EntireFM) is a UK provider of commercial facilities management, mechanical & electrical engineering (M&E), planned preventative maintenance (PPM), and building maintenance services.

## Core Service Capabilities (Derived from Verified Route Registry)
- **Hard FM & Building Engineering**: Mechanical & Electrical maintenance, commercial HVAC & air conditioning, statutory compliance, commercial plumbing, gas safety, and building fabric maintenance.
- **Specialist Maintenance**: Planned Preventative Maintenance (PPM) schedule design, asset surveying, and reactive repair coordination.
- **Soft FM & Site Services**: Commercial office and contract cleaning, industrial cleaning, security guarding, grounds maintenance, and aerial drone building inspections.
- **Total Facilities Management (TFM)**: Consolidated single-contract delivery across commercial, industrial, and logistics property portfolios.
- **Technology Integration**: Delivery supported by EntireCAFM, EntireFM's computer-aided facilities management system and building performance telemetry.

## Verified Operational Entity Facts
- **Entity**: Entire Facilities Management Ltd
- **Trading Name**: EntireFM
- **Primary Website**: https://www.entirefm.com
- **Operating Model**: Mobile regional engineering and FM delivery teams operating across UK commercial estates, with response times agreed per site.
